name: CEGT Replacement Project
researcher_notes: The EIA pipeline projects release for August 2026, sheet Historical Projects (1996-2024), Excel row 492, lists a CenterPoint Energy Gas Transmission project of 25 miles of 24 inch pipe in Arkansas, Federal Energy Regulatory Commission docket CP07-404, completed March 2008, cost 17.7 million dollars. The project type is Expansion, but the project name says it replaced existing pipe on the Enable Gas Transmission system (existing rows P0161 and P2560). No source found states that new route miles or new capacity were added, so the 25 mile length is not confirmed as new pipe. It is already in service, and a 2008 replacement is not a concrete pending step. No second independent source was found, because the FERC filing could not be reached through search. Not added. Treat as monitor for length, and as a possible historical record only if a person decides replaced pipe on the existing system should be tracked.
